# Bundled third-party files

These files are copied into the project so SoluAI works without internet.

| Folder / file | What | Version | License |
|---|---|---|---|
| `plotly-2.35.2.min.js` | Plotly.js charts | 2.35.2 | MIT (see `plotly-LICENSE.txt`) |
| `jsme/` | JSME molecule editor by Bruno Bienfait and Peter Ertl (npm `jsme-editor`) | 2024.04.29 | BSD-3-Clause |
| `fonts/inter-*.woff2` | Inter typeface (npm `@fontsource-variable/inter`) | 5.x | SIL Open Font License 1.1 |
| `fonts/jetbrains-mono-*.woff2` | JetBrains Mono (npm `@fontsource/jetbrains-mono`) | 5.x | SIL Open Font License 1.1 |
| `fonts/vazirmatn-*.woff2` | Vazirmatn Persian typeface by Saber Rastikerdar (npm `@fontsource-variable/vazirmatn`) | 5.x | SIL Open Font License 1.1 |

JSME: B. Bienfait and P. Ertl, "JSME: a free molecule editor in JavaScript",
*J. Cheminformatics* 5:24 (2013), doi:10.1186/1758-2946-5-24.
